result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Corio may terminate on 30 days' written notice without an early-termination charge, receives a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees for the post-termination period, and Commerce One has no convenience-termination right during a committed term. The existing end-of-term nonrenewal right remains permissible. However, adding a right to terminate “in whole or in part” goes beyond the stated playbook requirement and lacks mechanics for partial termination, so the revision is not strictly minimal.
